expectations.says: The anaesthesia layer does not write the anaesthetic as a visit detail or as a row of the anaesthetic table.
expectations.query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM omop.visit_detail vd WHERE vd.visit_detail_source_value = '990000631') AS visit_details, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM omop.anaesthetic a JOIN omop.visit_detail vd ON vd.visit_detail_id = a.visit_detail_id WHERE vd.visit_detail_source_value = '990000631') AS anaesthetics

expectations.says: The core still writes the child and the hospital visit.
expectations.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS visits FROM omop.visit_occurrence vo JOIN omop.person p ON p.person_id = vo.person_id WHERE p.person_source_value = '990000611'
